stories.headline: 斯里兰卡前第一夫人因捐款案被捕

freshness.development: 斯里兰卡前第一夫人因捐款案被捕
freshness.quote: Sri Lanka's former first lady Shiranthi Rajapaksa has been arrested over allegations that a charity she is linked to misused donations raised for a children's hospital.

claims.text: 斯里兰卡反腐部门周三逮捕前第一夫人希兰蒂·拉贾帕克萨，调查她关联的慈善机构是否挪用儿童医院捐款。涉案金额为1,000万斯里兰卡卢比，原计划用于购买专用扫描仪；官员称，中国政府此前已捐赠同类设备。

evidence.quote: Anti-corruption authorities arrested the 73-year-old wife of former President Mahinda Rajapaksa at their Colombo home on Wednesday.

They are questioning her over the 10 million rupees ($30,300; £22,800) of donations collected by the Siriliya Saviya charity, meant to be spent on a specialised scanner for Colombo's Lady Ridgeway Children's Hospital. But officials say such a scanner had already been donated by the Chinese government.

claims.text: 她否认挪用资金，前总统方面也称钱仍在慈善机构账户中。现政府正在重启涉及拉贾帕克萨家族的多项反腐调查。

evidence.quote: Shiranthi Rajapaksa has denied any wrongdoing and says the money has not been appropriated.
money is safe in Siriliya's accounts and that no fraud has occurred.
has since revived long-stalled corruption investigations involving various members of the Rajapaksa family.

cross_check.note: 依据列出的出版方报道整理，未宣称已全面独立核实。

stories.headline: IMF总裁警告：债务与借款成本持续攀升

freshness.development: IMF总裁警告：债务与借款成本持续攀升
freshness.quote: The head of the International Monetary Fund has called on governments across big economies to tighten their belts as soaring bond yields hit budgets.

claims.text: IMF总裁格奥尔基耶娃呼吁主要经济体收紧财政。她表示，全球债务占GDP的比例处于二战以来最高水平，未来几年可能达到100%；政府不能只依靠经济增长来减轻债务负担。

evidence.quote: The head of the International Monetary Fund has called on governments across big economies to tighten their belts as soaring bond yields hit budgets.
said global debt-to-GDP ratios were at their highest level since the second world war and on course to hit 100% in the coming years.
She said governments could not rely on rapid economic growth to lift the burden of debt

claims.text: 近期债券收益率上涨，使政府利息支出增加，同时国防等开支需求仍在上升。她主张高债务经济体制定可信的中期财政整顿计划，并建议央行准备应对重新抬头的通胀。

evidence.quote: Elevated yields are inflating the interest bill at a time of tight budget constraints and competing spending priorities, including defence
credible medium-term fiscal consolidation plans
The Bulgarian economist suggested central banks should be prepared to raise interest rates to see off resurgent inflation.

cross_check.note: 依据列出的出版方报道整理，未宣称已全面独立核实。

stories.headline: 英国9月房价停滞，房贷成本压制市场

freshness.development: 英国9月房价停滞，房贷成本压制市场
freshness.quote: The average cost of a home was £298,441, roughly the same as it was a year earlier and in the previous month, according to the tracker from Lloyds previously known as the Halifax HPI.

claims.text: 劳埃德银行公布的指数显示，英国9月平均房价为298,441英镑，与8月和一年前基本持平，低于经济学家预期的环比上涨0.1%。8月房价曾下跌0.3%，为三年来首次下降。

evidence.quote: The average cost of a home was £298,441, roughly the same as it was a year earlier and in the previous month
Economists polled by Reuters had predicted a 0.1% monthly rise in prices
house prices fell by 0.3% in August , the first decline in three years

claims.text: 五年期固定房贷的平均利率已升至6%，为三年来首次。全球债市动荡推高银行贷款报价，即使英国央行基准利率没有同步变化，购房者和需要续贷的家庭仍面临更高成本。

evidence.quote: On Monday the average cost of a five-year fixed-rate mortgage reached 6% for the first time in three years

In recent weeks most big banks and building societies have put prices up as a result of turmoil in the global bond markets, even though there has not been a change in the Bank of England base rate since December last year.
Rising mortgage rates are bad news for borrowers whose fixed-rate deals are ending

stories.headline: 欧盟赴华谈贸易，聚焦混合动力汽车出口

freshness.development: 欧盟赴华谈贸易，聚焦混合动力汽车出口
freshness.quote: Trade commissioner Maroš Šefčovič and his team fly out on Wednesday and will be negotiating up to the wire in talks scheduled to start the following day and continue late into Friday.

claims.text: 欧盟贸易委员谢夫乔维奇率团队周三赴中国，计划周四、周五展开贸易磋商。谈判重点之一是中国混合动力汽车出口；欧方希望先在单个行业达成试点安排，再考虑扩大到其他领域。

evidence.quote: Trade commissioner Maroš Šefčovič and his team fly out on Wednesday and will be negotiating up to the wire in talks scheduled to start the following day and continue late into Friday.

The main focus is on what has been described as a “proof of concept” pilot agreement involving one sector, which is expected to be cars, which could be scaled up for other sectors in the coming months.

claims.text: 欧盟2024年对中国纯电动车加征关税后，未受同类关税限制的混合动力汽车出口增加。欧方上月要求中国自愿限制这类出口，并警告可能采取包括配额在内的保障措施。

evidence.quote: after the EU imposed tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles in October 2024 there was a boom in exports of hybrid cars , which were not subject to tariffs.
Last month, the EU asked China to voluntarily restrict hybrid exports to address soaring sales, warning that if they did not restrict them, safeguards – which could include quotas – could be enacted.

cross_check.note: 依据列出的出版方报道整理，未宣称已全面独立核实。

stories.headline: 皇家邮政拟裁减最多2,500个岗位

freshness.development: 皇家邮政拟裁减最多2,500个岗位
freshness.quote: The postal service, which has been fined a total of £37m since 2023 for missing delivery targets set by the regulator Ofcom, said the job cuts would focus on head office and “support function roles” with the restructure to be completed by the end of next year.

claims.text: 皇家邮政计划裁减最多2,500个岗位，主要涉及总部和支持职能，重组拟在明年年底前完成。公司称，将通过自然减员和自愿离职实施，不进行强制裁员，也不会减少投递和处理业务的一线岗位。

evidence.quote: Royal Mail is to cut up to 2,500 jobs
the job cuts would focus on head office and “support function roles” with the restructure to be completed by the end of next year.
the cuts would be achieved through “natural attrition” and a voluntary exit programme with no compulsory redundancies.
there would be no reduction in operational frontline roles in delivery and processing

claims.text: 信件投递量较2000年代中期的峰值已下降逾70%。此次裁员规模不到公司13.1万多名员工的2%；代表一线员工的工会称，约200名从事行政和收入保障工作的会员会受到影响。

evidence.quote: the volume of letter deliveries had declined more than 70% since their peak in the mid-00s
The cuts amount to less than 2% of Royal Mail’s workforce of more than 131,000.
said about 200 members with jobs in administration and revenue protection would be affected.

stories.headline: 壳牌预计炼油利润率明显上升

freshness.development: 壳牌预计炼油利润率明显上升
freshness.quote: In a trading update on Wednesday, the energy supermajor forecast profit margins of $42 a barrel in the July to September period, far above the margins of $24 a barrel in the second quarter.

claims.text: 壳牌在交易更新中预计，第三季度每桶炼油利润率将达到42美元，高于第二季度的24美元，也超过俄乌战争初期约28美元的此前纪录。这反映柴油等成品油价格相对原油成本明显上涨。

evidence.quote: forecast profit margins of $42 a barrel in the July to September period, far above the margins of $24 a barrel in the second quarter.
The forecast margins are also significantly higher than the previous record for petroleum products of about $28 a barrel, set in the early months of the Russia-Ukraine war.
The margins reflect the steep increase in the price of refined fuels, including diesel, relative to the cost of the crude oil.

claims.text: 《卫报》报道，中东和俄罗斯部分炼油设施受到战争破坏，造成燃料供应紧张。原油出口部分恢复后，原油价格有所缓和，但成品油价格仍在上升，扩大了炼油业务的利润空间。

evidence.quote: A partial recovery of Gulf oil exports has allowed crude market prices to ease back to about $100 a barrel, while war damage to refineries in the Middle East and Russia has caused fuel prices to continue to climb.
That gap should make larger profits possible for refineries

cross_check.note: 依据列出的出版方报道整理，未宣称已全面独立核实。

someone with a key can use a specialized detector to find.
